faqs.a: Yes. A young line can still have a sag, a joint problem or debris.

faqs.q: Is service available at my address?
faqs.a: Availability has to be confirmed for the address and the work. A request is not a booked appointment or a promise of service.

neighborhoods.ctaP: Describe what is happening at your Waukee property. Include the affected fixtures, how long the problem has lasted, any earlier inspection findings and known access limits.
